# Alchemy content (doc 86). Province scope unless said.

# An unknown deposit no survey works on yet.
DA_ALC_surveyable_common = {
	has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_material.Unknown.common
	NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_Material_exploration_workaround }
}
DA_ALC_surveyable_rare = {
	has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_material.Unknown.rare
	NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_Material_exploration_workaround }
}
DA_ALC_surveyable_legendary = {
	has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_material.Unknown.legendary
	NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_Material_exploration_workaround }
}

# Country scope. The Sources page's survey: at peace, a deposit to survey, and the price of the cheapest kind there is
# (as the province view's survey).
DA_ALC_can_survey = {
	is_at_war = no
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_ALC_survey_some_tt
		any_owned_province = { OR = { DA_ALC_surveyable_common = yes DA_ALC_surveyable_rare = yes DA_ALC_surveyable_legendary = yes } }
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_ALC_survey_price_tt
		OR = {
			AND = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.Aerial_Survey any_owned_province = { DA_ALC_surveyable_common = yes } dip_power = 10 manpower = 0.5 treasury = 25 }
			AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.Aerial_Survey } any_owned_province = { DA_ALC_surveyable_common = yes } dip_power = 20 manpower = 1 treasury = 50 }
			AND = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.Aerial_Survey NOT = { any_owned_province = { DA_ALC_surveyable_common = yes } } any_owned_province = { DA_ALC_surveyable_rare = yes } dip_power = 20 manpower = 1 treasury = 50 }
			AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.Aerial_Survey } NOT = { any_owned_province = { DA_ALC_surveyable_common = yes } } any_owned_province = { DA_ALC_surveyable_rare = yes } dip_power = 40 manpower = 2 treasury = 100 }
			AND = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.Aerial_Survey NOT = { any_owned_province = { DA_ALC_surveyable_common = yes } } NOT = { any_owned_province = { DA_ALC_surveyable_rare = yes } } any_owned_province = { DA_ALC_surveyable_legendary = yes } dip_power = 40 manpower = 2.5 treasury = 100 }
			AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.Aerial_Survey } NOT = { any_owned_province = { DA_ALC_surveyable_common = yes } } NOT = { any_owned_province = { DA_ALC_surveyable_rare = yes } } any_owned_province = { DA_ALC_surveyable_legendary = yes } dip_power = 80 manpower = 5 treasury = 200 }
		}
	}
}

# Cultivation (doc 86). The province view, FROM the viewer: the Cultivate button takes the survey's place in a province
# of ours with an Alchemy Workshop or better, from Alchemy II, when there is nothing there to survey.
DA_ALC_show_cultivate = {
	owned_by = FROM
	FROM = { DA_completed.Alchemy_2 = yes }
	OR = { has_building = DA_Alchemy_workshop_1 has_building = DA_Alchemy_workshop_2 has_building = DA_Alchemy_workshop_3 }
	NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_material.Unknown.common }
	NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_material.Unknown.rare }
	NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_material.Unknown.legendary }
	NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_Material_exploration_workaround }
}

DA_ALC_can_cultivate = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_ALC_cult_one_tt
		owner = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_ALC_cultivating } }
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_ALC_cult_some_tt
		DA_ALC_cultivable_here = yes
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {   # the price of something that can be grown here
		tooltip = DA_ALC_cult_price_tt
		OR = {
			AND = { OR = { DA_ALC_grow_Ironroot = yes DA_ALC_grow_Silverleaf = yes DA_ALC_grow_Sageleaf = yes DA_ALC_grow_Embergrass = yes DA_ALC_grow_Glowberry = yes DA_ALC_grow_Duskfern = yes DA_ALC_grow_Stormvine = yes DA_ALC_grow_Honeyroot = yes DA_ALC_grow_Shadowmoss = yes DA_ALC_grow_Golden_Thistle = yes DA_ALC_grow_Bloodflower = yes } owner = { treasury = 100 check_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 10 } } }
			AND = { OR = { DA_ALC_grow_Crypt_Shroom = yes DA_ALC_grow_Mandrake_Root = yes DA_ALC_grow_Azure_Lotus = yes DA_ALC_grow_Crimson_Thistle = yes DA_ALC_grow_Drasil_Bark = yes DA_ALC_grow_Fey_Amber = yes DA_ALC_grow_Devouring_Gourd = yes } owner = { treasury = 250 check_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 20 } } }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Equivalent Exchange (doc 86): Alchemy IV, an exchange left this year, and 6 of one of the three.
DA_ALC_can_exchange = {
	DA_completed.Alchemy_4 = yes
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_ALC_ex_left_tt
		NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_ALC_ex_used value = 5 } }
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_ALC_ex_some_tt
		OR = { check_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 6 } check_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 6 } check_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 6 } }
	}
}
